sources.title: scienceverse/bibr-extract-qwen35-4b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: bibr-extract-qwen35-4b This is the structured-extraction student model used by bibr. It answers bibr's extraction prompts (statistical equations, reference segmentation, funding / contributions / affiliations, …) in JSON. The model is Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B fine-tuned on answers from a larger teacher model, with the LoRA merged into full bf16 weights.
